The '''Ebon Coursers''' were a group of seven [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] who worked for [[Schnil Hakoon/Legends|Schnil Hakoon]] as his own personal [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] unit on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kirtania]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They were charged with recovering the [[Amber Eye]] from the [[Scoundrel/Legends|thief]] [[Pierce Mantrell]].
